language.interfaceHint: Changes at once, everywhere in the app.

thresholds.title: Confidence thresholds
thresholds.body: Mona files on her own above the high threshold, files and marks it between the two, and asks you below the low one. New values apply to documents read from now on.
thresholds.lowHint: Below this confidence a document goes to review.
thresholds.badgeHint: How long a document Mona filed carries the badge.

thresholds.earlyHint: While a batch is still running, Mona starts her questions once this many documents need an answer.

status.failed: Mona couldn’t read the system status.

privacy.title: Privacy · where your data goes
privacy.limit: Deleting a visitor’s document removes its files, extracted text, suggestions, journal rows and deadlines. A conversation about it in chat stays in that conversation.

stays.title: Stays on this computer
stays.thinking: Mona’s reading and thinking: the AI runs here
stays.index: The search index and the journal
stays.visitors_one: Documents from visitors: deleted after {{count}} hour, with everything Mona derived from them
stays.visitors_other: Documents from visitors: deleted after {{count}} hours, with everything Mona derived from them

cloud.title: Goes to a cloud AI service
cloud.body: This is a development setup: the text of documents Mona reads is sent to a cloud AI service. The practice’s own installation keeps the AI on its computer.

telegram.title: Passes through Telegram
telegram.body: Messages you exchange with Mona on Telegram travel through Telegram’s servers. She keeps names, amounts, dates and anything medical out of the first line.
telegram.personal: Documents of personal entities, and of visitors, never appear there.

export.title: Leaves only when you export
export.body: Accountant exports go where you save them. Personal and visitor documents are never included. Mona never sends anything by herself.

firstRun.title: Let’s get Mona started
firstRun.intro: A few things, in any order. Nothing here is permanent.

language.title: Your language
language.body: Mona shows the app, dates and amounts in this language. You can change it later in Settings.

entities.title: Your entities
entities.body: Companies, rentals and households whose paperwork Mona files. The installer sets them up; check them here.

archive.title: Archive folder
archive.body: Mona files into one folder on this computer and mirrors it exactly. The installer picks the folder.

documents.title: Your first documents
documents.body: Drop a few documents in Intake and watch Mona read and file them.

telegram.title: Telegram
telegram.body: Mona’s Telegram bot is set up by the installer. Nothing to do here.

offline.title: Mona’s brain is offline
offline.body: Chat and questions wait until it is back. You can still look at documents, search and file them yourself.
